## Mouser v3.7.19 - Windows QtWidgets startup fix

This release fixes a Windows portable-package startup failure that could show:

```text
DLL load failed while importing QtWidgets
```

### Fixed

- Adds the bundled PySide6 and shiboken6 folders to the Windows DLL search path
  before importing Qt, so extracted portable packages can find QtWidgets and its
  runtime dependencies more reliably on other PCs.
- Declares `PySide6.QtWidgets` explicitly in the Windows PyInstaller build.

### Note

- The Windows package is still a portable folder package. Extract the whole
  `Mouser` folder first, then run `Mouser.exe`; do not run the exe directly
  from inside the zip or move `Mouser.exe` away from `_internal`.
